text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Again…… Today was not quite the Bakushin I 
envisioned!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what's wrong with me, my legs 
are……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Could it be, if I continue on like this 
for the rest of my life… I'll be an Uma 
Musume that is unworthy of being a role 
model for anyone……!?
choice_data_list: It's not like you to be so down!
It's not like you to be so down!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Trainer who was given 
the honor of being dubbed "Sakura Bakushin 
O's Trainer"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your enthusiasm is different! Your 
reliability is different! Big difference, 
big savior!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, just like Trainer said, I'm totally, 
110% capable of Bakushin! Yes, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! If not today, there's always 
tomorrow! Come on now, Bakushiiiiiiiin!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was a close one, I was nearly 
swallowed by the evil spirit of the turf!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The spirit….has tested this class 
president, hasn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Worry not! I shall crush the evil spirits 
with my Bakushin!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No matter if you're God or the Great Demon 
King! I won't let you stop my 
Bakushin-ing!!
